comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: For me at least, this item is needed for one of the Atlantis solar barge part deliveries this week. Pick any quest above which isn't Xerxes related, and you're bound to have good success; I personally like King of Hellenistic Greece since it comes from Athens, goes to Alexandria, and finishes in Beirut where the orb has to be dropped off anyway.

comments.author: Name
comments.body: @BonnyLass - Thank you, my dear, for the hint. Saved a world of time and trouble!

comments.author: Scrimshaw
comments.body: "The gentle emperor" is the gravy quest for English and Dutch Secret Edict delivery... Pulled in your home city, and just cut through Paris, stop in Naples to dig up your orb and on to Beirut to deliver it.
